key_insight: A multispectral metasurface paired with a hybrid CNN-ViT model can improve skin lesion classification by capturing both spectral detail and complementary local-global image features.
clinical_relevance: This approach may support faster, noninvasive, and more accurate early skin cancer screening than conventional RGB-based imaging.
method: Metasurface-based multispectral imaging to collect rich spectral tissue information.
Hybrid deep learning model combining Convolutional Neural Networks and Vision Transformers.
Attention maps used to highlight clinically relevant lesion regions and improve interpretability.
evidence_signal: In simulation-based evaluation, the method achieved about 98% accuracy, 95% sensitivity, and 99% specificity, outperforming RGB-only and single-architecture baselines.
watch_item: Results are simulation-based, so real-world clinical validation, device robustness, and generalization across patient populations still need confirmation.
paper_title: Intelligent Skin Cancer Detection Using a Multispectral Metasurface and a Hybrid
